description: Template schema for conversation state stored in Redis. One Redis hash per session; each field is a turn id (auto-incremental) whose value is a JSON-encoded string of the turn.
field_notes: turn_id is an auto-incremental integer starting at 1 (e.g. HLEN + 1).

turn_schema.user_query: string - message sent by the user
turn_schema.system_response: string - response returned by the system
turn_schema.subsystem_chosen: string - id of the subsystem selected by the orchestrator (see config/systems.json)

fields.1: {"user_query": "Create a 3-day push/pull/legs routine for me", "system_response": "Here is your 3-day PPL routine: ...", "subsystem_chosen": "routine_maker"}
fields.2: {"user_query": "How do I perform a barbell bench press?", "system_response": "1. Lie on the bench with your feet flat...", "subsystem_chosen": "exercise_explainer"}
fields.3: {"user_query": "How has my chest volume changed over the last month?", "system_response": "Your weekly chest volume increased by 12%...", "subsystem_chosen": "past_routines_analyzer"}
